definitions.explanation: To bring and hand over goods, mail, food, or other items to a designated destination. Used for postal delivery, package delivery, food delivery, and newspaper delivery.

examples.japanese: {荷物|にもつ}を{配達|はいたつ}する。
{新聞|しんぶん}は{毎朝|まいあさ}{配達|はいたつ}される。
examples.english: The newspaper is delivered every morning.

examples.japanese: {注文|ちゅうもん}した{料理|りょうり}が30{分|ぷん}で{配達|はいたつ}された。
examples.english: The food I ordered was delivered in 30 minutes.

notes:
A practical everyday word that has become even more common with the rise of food delivery services and online shopping.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {配達|はいたつ}{員|いん}: delivery person
- {配達|はいたつ}{日|び}: delivery date
- {配達|はいたつ}{時間|じかん}: delivery time
- {配達|はいたつ}{先|さき}: delivery destination
- {宅配|たくはい}{便|びん}: home delivery service
- {配達|はいたつ}{証明|しょうめい}: proof of delivery

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {届|とど}ける: to deliver — native Japanese verb, more general, also used for submitting documents
- {配達|はいたつ}する: to deliver — specifically refers to the delivery of goods to a destination as a service
- {配送|はいそう}する: to ship, to dispatch — focuses on the shipping/logistics process rather than the final handoff
